description: Run a Google search through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com) and return the results page as JSON: organic results with their real URLs, favicons, sitelinks and star ratings, ads, the AI Overview, People also ask, related searches with their links, the knowledge panel, top stories, videos, local and shopping results. Set `full_urls` when you need the exact page URL of every result.

full_urls.description: Wait until Google gives out every result's real URL. Set it when you need the exact page URL of all results (e.g. to cite or open them); leave it off for quick answers. Google releases a results page's links a few at a time, the last ones up to about 40 seconds after the search: without it a result whose link has not come yet has the site's home page as its `url` (or a Google redirect link), with it the call takes up to about 40 seconds longer. Billed the same.

pages_to_check.description: How many result pages to collect (default 1).

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to search from, e.g. 'US'.

name: google_search
title: Google search results
